name: E-commerce Customer Preference
dataset: Kaggle Amazon Fine Food Reviews (Reviews.csv; 568454 raw rows)

fields.name: Text
fields.label: Review text
fields.example: Fresh, tasty and exactly as described. I would buy it again.

fields.name: HelpfulnessDenominator
fields.label: Total votes
fields.description: Total helpfulness votes; must be at least helpful votes

target.name: Positive Preference
target.definition: Score 4-5 = Positive; Score 1-2 = Negative; Score 3 excluded

representation: Combined Summary + Text TF-IDF (unigrams/bigrams) plus five engineered numerical features
limitations: Preference is a rating-derived proxy, not independently observed intent
Product/user identifiers are excluded and near-duplicate language may remain
disclaimer: This is an educational prediction of review preference, not a measurement of actual customer intention.
